BOX step 2 — edge-gap prototype: Delaware WCA

Grain: one row per api10 lateral. Evidence = gate-1 final set wells_final_WCA.csv with first production ≥ 2016-01-01 (n = 11,146; WCA_1 + WCA_2 + WCXY one-way, D19/D20); pre-2016 pool laterals (n = 1,160) are negative evidence only (grey). Geometry: enverus_lateralline 11,105, novi_lp_bhl 26, wellstick 15. Outline = laterals dilated by r = 2,640 ft, closed by c = 3,960 ft (0.75 mi, tuned on WCA). 12-mo oil = Novi cum_12m_oil_bbl ÷ lateral_length_ft × 1,000 (calendar basis as Novi computed it), D9 cohort wells only (first prod ≥ 2016, lateral 6,000–13,000 ft, 12 full months). Built 2026-10-07T15:32:26-05:00. Read-only; nothing written to the warehouse. Plan: docs/box_type_curves_plan.md §5 step 2.

Expected-result test

Expected: WCA uniformly pinned. Every side is 61%–74% pinned with 10%–21% of its perimeter in gaps > 1 mi (overall 66% pinned, gap median 3,400 ft, p90 7,500 ft, 1.63 perimeter-mi per pinning well); 25 step-out laterals beyond the body. Reads as uniform: no side stands out.

Tuning rule (WCA): the smallest c that makes WCA one body (one component with ≥ 5 laterals) at r = 0.5 mi. Larger c bridges more (fewer holes, longer gaps, lower pinned share); larger r pins more ground per lateral.
